pages.text: The liquid fuel line consists of five steps: $(bold)liquefy → process → mix → can → burn$(reset).$(br2)$(li)$(l:akaishi:fuel_liquefier)Energy Liquefier$(/l): converts solid ingredients into liquid energy$(li)$(l:akaishi:fuel_processor)Energy Processor$(/l): converts liquid energy into burnable fuel$(li)$(l:akaishi:fuel_mixer)Fuel Mixer$(/l): blends low-tier fuel into high-tier fuel$(li)$(l:akaishi:fuel_canner)Fuel Canner$(/l): fills fuel cells with liquid$(br2)The filled cells are used in $(l:akaishi:reactor)The Reactor$(/l); the highest-tier fuel is further processed in the $(l:akaishi:plasma)Plasma Chain$(/l). Recipes and stats for each machine are in their own entries.

$(bold)Line logistics:$(reset)$(li)Fluid Tanks: Basic 16,000 mb / Advanced 64,000 mb / Super 256,000 mb; output should settle in a tank before the next stage so machines do not wait$(li)Fluid Pipe: moves 4,000 mb/tick of any liquid$(br2)$(bold)Exception:$(reset) exhausted fuel is corrosive and must use the dedicated $(bold)Sealed Exhausted Pipe$(reset); normal pipes reject it.$(br2)Its recycling route is in Secrets of Life; in the meantime, it must not be discarded.
Upstream is $(l:akaishi:fuel_system)Fuel & Cooling$(/l) and downstream is $(l:akaishi:reactor)The Reactor$(/l); the top product of this line is further processed in the Plasma Chain.
